A Stone Wall with a gate. Anyone presses T at it (or OPEN in the commander view) to open or close it. While it's open, enemies can walk through too. It shuts itself 6 s after you're clear. A little weaker than a plain wall.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Defense |
| Main crystal | Obsidian |
| Build cost | 25 Obsidian |
| Upgrades give | +HP (anyone opens / closes it) |

## Levels

The cost on level 1 is the build cost; on later levels it is the cost to upgrade to that level.
